summary:
Updated implementation plan for PolyMap SPbPU:
1. Re-architected 3-tab bottom navigation (Сервисы, Карта, Главное).
2. Multi-Design Engine: Selectable UI design presets inspired by scrn.gallery (Minimal iOS Dock, Neumorphic Glass, Compact Utility, Expressive M3) switching layout, icon sizes, card formats, and visual density.
3. Smart Natural Language Search: Parses complex student queries like 'преподователь химии у направления мехатроники и робототехники 1 курса группы 60002', returning teachers with photos and class type breakdown (Полякова - лекция, Бочагина - практика, Крылов).
4. Authentic PolyMap Campus & Floor map with building outlines, interactive room lookup, floor selector (Ц, 1..4), and classroom timetables.
5. Figma Import Guide explaining step-by-step export to Figma.
